originalReview.notes: Exact local native inspected first with EXIF orientation honored. Head deck looking landward shows repeated white open fan/leaf cast-metal panels with dark green stock, timber deck, center lamp/bench row, two shelters and distant white domed pavilion. Temporary string lights, people/birds and loose furnishings excluded. Four-counter casting is original simplified medium-fi geometry, not an exact casting reproduction; photo does not establish full pavilion exterior or supports.

Exact3060x4080native inspected, including orientation-correct display: full restored landward pavilion entrance,paired dome/tower/lattice groups,curved balcony/lower columns and low shop wings. No temporary signs/vehicles/cables copied.
